text.text: Tinted seared glass is transparent while blocking light. In the default smeltery rules it can form a wall, but not the floor.

Craft one block with four Seared Bricks around vanilla Tinted Glass or Clear Tinted Glass: place a brick above, below, left and right of the glass. The input uses the forge:glass/tinted tag, so datapacks may change the accepted glass.
Actual crafting, light updates in existing worlds, the in-game appearance, and LAN behavior have not been verified.
